candidates.title: Lorry collides with RTC bus in Hyderabad, 12 injured
candidates.excerpt: Hyderabad: As many as 12 people were injured after a lorry collided with a Telangana State Road Transport Corporation (TGSRTC) bus on Tuesday, September 15, near Kuntloor Rajiv Gruhakalp. The lorry hit the bus on the side, shattering windows. A video of the incident shows pieces of glass strewn across the seats and the floor. …

candidates.title: CM Revanth Reddy Meets Prince Rahim Aga Khan V, Seeks Support for Hyderabad Heritage and Musi Rejuvenation
candidates.excerpt: Telangana Chief Minister A. Revanth Reddy met Prince Rahim Aga Khan V at the historic Taj Falaknuma Palace in Hyderabad and sought support from the Aga Khan Foundation for the preservation of Hyderabad’s heritage and the rejuvenation of the Musi River.

candidates.title: 20 Injured as Tipper Lorry Collides with RTC Bus Near Kuntloor in Hayathnagar
candidates.excerpt: According to preliminary information, the RTC bus was carrying passengers when the tipper lorry reportedly crashed into the bus. The impact caused panic among passengers and people in the surrounding area.

candidates.title: Seven held for ‘purification’ after protest near KCR’s farmhouse in Telangana
candidates.excerpt: Telangana Police have arrested seven people in a case relating to the alleged ‘purification’ of roads at Erravalli near the farmhouse of BRS president and former Chief Minister K. Chandrasekhar Rao in Siddipet district.

candidates.title: Vice President to be chief guest of ‘Hyderabad Liberation Day’
candidates.excerpt: Hyderabad: Vice President C P Radhakrishnan will be the chief guest of the “Hyderabad Liberation Day” celebrations to be organised here by the Centre on September 17. Union Coal and Mines Minister G Kishan Reddy, who inspected the arrangements for the event at Parade Grounds here on Tuesday, said Union Culture Minister Gajendra Singh Shekhawat …

candidates.title: CM Revanth Reddy Likely to Visit Hyderabad Old City Soon, To Meet Aga Khan–5
candidates.excerpt: The proposed meeting is expected to assume significance as the state government continues to focus on the development and infrastructure needs of Hyderabad’s Old City. The Chief Minister’s visit is also likely to draw attention among local residents and community representatives.

candidates.title: Former Andhra Pradesh Deputy Chief Minister Alla Nani dies of cardiac arrest at 56
candidates.excerpt: The Eluru leader was Health Minister through the pandemic in the Y.S. Jagan Mohan Reddy government, lost his seat in 2024, quit the YSRCP that August and joined the TDP in February 2025

candidates.title: Fire breaks out at automobile service centre in Keralam’s Kochi; none injured
candidates.excerpt: The blaze broke out when workers were uninstalling steel frames of the facility as part of relocation

candidates.title: Hyderabad: Rowdy sheeter hacked to death in permit room at Bandlaguda
candidates.excerpt: A rowdy sheeter identified as Nayeem from Yellandu was hacked to death by unidentified assailants at a wine shop permit room in Bandlaguda under Nagole Police Station limits. Police suspect old enmity and gang rivalry behind the murder.

candidates.title: Telangana records highest retail inflation among major Southern States in August
candidates.excerpt: Telangana recorded 6.27 per cent retail inflation in August, the highest among major Southern States, with rural inflation at 6.79 per cent. The State has remained above 6 per cent for several months after moving sharply from deflation in 2025.

candidates.title: Suspected sabotage triggers major Dutch rail outage during morning rush hour
candidates.excerpt: There was no immediate indication of who was suspected of being behind the apparent sabotage

candidates.title: Delhi airport sees protest as Dubai-bound SpiceJet flights face disruption
candidates.excerpt: Passengers of two SpiceJet flights from Delhi to Dubai faced prolonged delays with one flight remaining grounded for more than 24 hours, leading to protests at Delhi airport on Tuesday, a report said.
